# Aditya Singhal: assistant and developer resources

> Connect to Adi's Ambipath website assistant, or read public profile, project, writing and workshop information.

## Ask Adi's assistant

Website: https://adityasinghal.com/

Public questions can be asked without a browser or customer sign-in.

- Connection instructions: https://console.ambipath.com/api/v1/public/a6436a43-e728-456d-879c-c7674b0d814f/agent.md
- Guest HTTP API: https://console.ambipath.com/api/v1/public/a6436a43-e728-456d-879c-c7674b0d814f
- API contract: https://console.ambipath.com/api/public-openapi.json
- PAP discovery: https://assistant-5fb03649c9914801a952129b908a3ac9.agents.ambipath.com/.well-known/poppy.json

Use the guest HTTP API when your client does not support PAP. A PAP client signs a fresh Poppy-Session proof for each request using its own published identity. A missing proof is not a request to sign in as the website owner.


PAP clients can also use the [MCP transport](https://assistant-5fb03649c9914801a952129b908a3ac9.agents.ambipath.com/mcp) and [conversations endpoint](https://assistant-5fb03649c9914801a952129b908a3ac9.agents.ambipath.com/conversations) with signed request proofs. See [access details](https://adityasinghal.com/auth.md) for the guest session flow, optional customer-account access and the separate public data API.

## Public data

Use these resources to integrate the public information into a directory, learning assistant or profile summary. No account or API key is needed.

- [Developer guide](https://adityasinghal.com/developers.md): examples, response handling and version policy.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://adityasinghal.com/openapi.json): exact GET operations and response schemas.
- [API index](https://adityasinghal.com/api/v1/index.json): the four available data documents.
- [Agent instructions](https://adityasinghal.com/agents.md): source selection and citation guidance.
- [Access policy](https://adityasinghal.com/auth.md): assistant session requirements, unauthenticated public data and errors.
- [Root reading map](https://adityasinghal.com/llms.txt): profile, projects, writing and teaching.
